options.particles.minecraft.block_crumbl: Produced when a Creaking Heart is destroyed, along with its Creaking.
options.particles.minecraft.ominous_spaw: Produced when an ominous item spawner spawns an item during an ominous event.
sodium-extra.option.advanced_fog_setting: Unlocks per-dimension and protected gameplay fog controls. When off, the global fog settings below apply everywhere.
sodium-extra.option.cloud_fog.tooltip:
Controls how far into the cloud render distance clouds fully fade into fog. Fading begins at the camera.
100%: Vanilla cloud fog
sodium-extra.option.cloud_height_overrid: Overrides dimension-defined cloud heights with Sodium Extra's Cloud Height setting.
sodium-extra.option.fog_distance.tooltip:
Adjusts atmospheric terrain fog distance.
0: Use vanilla fog settings
1+: Set fog distance in chunks
Off: Disable atmospheric terrain fog
sodium-extra.option.fog_shape.tooltip:
Controls which camera distance atmospheric terrain fog uses.
Vanilla: Match Minecraft's current render-distance fog shape
Cylindrical: Use horizontal distance with a taller vertical cap
Radial: Use true spherical distance from the camera
Planar: Use distance to the camera plane (view depth); fog shifts as you turn
sodium-extra.option.wayland_fullscreen_r: Allows Sodium's fullscreen resolution control to be used on Wayland or XWayland. Real X11 enables this automatically; Wayland and XWayland support is experimental because behavior depends on the compositor. If a selected mode prevents the game from starting cleanly, Sodium Extra will disable this option and reset fullscreen on the next launch.

This resolution is experimental on Wayland/XWayland and may not display correctly. If you can read this, choose Keep. If the screen is black or unusable, do nothing - the previous resolution will be restored automatically.
sodium-extra.option.panini_projection.to: Applies an experimental Panini screen projection to world rendering only. Disabled while Iris shader packs or Prevent Shaders are active.
sodium-extra.option.panini_projection_st: Controls the Panini projection argument used to remap the world image after rendering.
sodium-extra.option.protected_gameplay_f: Allows advanced fog distance changes for gameplay-affecting fog in private singleplayer worlds, LAN worlds with cheats enabled, or servers that authorize it through Greenlight. Multiplayer authorization requires Greenlight installed. These controls use block distances.

Adjusts blindness fog when local play allows it or the server authorizes it with Greenlight.
0: Use vanilla fog settings
1+: Set fog distance in blocks; full vanilla blindness is about 5 blocks
Off: Disable this fog

Adjusts darkness fog when local play allows it or the server authorizes it with Greenlight.
0: Use vanilla fog settings
1+: Set fog distance in blocks; vanilla darkness trends toward about 15 blocks
Off: Disable this fog

Adjusts lava fog when local play allows it or the server authorizes it with Greenlight.
0: Use vanilla fog settings
1+: Set fog distance in blocks; vanilla lava is about 1 block, or 5 blocks with Fire Resistance
Off: Disable this fog

Adjusts powder snow fog when local play allows it or the server authorizes it with Greenlight.
0: Use vanilla fog settings
1+: Set fog distance in blocks; vanilla powder snow is about 2 blocks
Off: Disable this fog

Adjusts underwater fog when local play allows it or the server authorizes it with Greenlight.
0: Use vanilla fog settings
1+: Set fog distance in blocks; vanilla water varies by biome and water vision
Off: Disable this fog
sodium-extra.option.more_hud_overlays.to: Opens the vanilla Debug Options screen (F3+F6), which can show more debug labels on the F3 screen or as persistent overlays.
